text_block_list.text: Rewinding time just a little—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ……The final "Japan Cup" in my "memories".

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: In that Japan Cup, eras truly clashed against one another.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The continuation of her supremacy, or the dawn of a new era.
Everyone watching dreamed of all the possibilities—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: That answer was vividly demonstrated.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: The me from another world ran in that race and witnessed the answer, but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I could never become a key player in this era.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Which is precisely why I feel so strongly about it.
choice_data_list: —This time, it's your turn to decide...!
—This time, it's your turn to decide...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...As someone aiming to be at the center of the era—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I will decide where this era heads.

"...Just like her, I clench my fist tightly.
To share that same resolve."
choice_data_list: I am right here with you.

text_block_list.text:
As your traveling companion, and as your Trainer.
What we strive for remains unchanged.
Now, and always—
choice_data_list: Let's enjoy this trip to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: If it's with you, I'm sure――
And time moves forward to where the traveler now stands—
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"—Knights!
And young Werther, who seeks to shatter gold!!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Take pride—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To fall before me,
and become a page in the chronicles of the Overlord's path...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now of all times, her presence is even more intense...!
Still, I won't lose...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san...
I will etch my name...
into your page...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Three powerful presences that feel as if they could repaint the entire landscape... Three of them...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ――Opera O.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, Pokke-san.
What a truly magnificent presence you have.
————Though still second to mine, of course."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Right here, you're the closest to the 'top.'
I understand that all too well. But—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm just close.
I'm not standing there yet...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "I'll prove it to you by standing at the very 'top'!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!! Splendid spirit!
Feel free to bare your fangs against this Overlord to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...One word of advice, however.
We are not the only ones blessed by the stage.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Look, it's coming. The one who brings the flames of the end—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Thanks for the grand introduction.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Mind if I join in, too?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Stego...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (Opera O and Pocket... So they have indeed achieved it.)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(Into something close to what T.M. Opera O
and Jungle Pocket had back then—)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Bring it on...! I'll crush you and Opera O together...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
And I'll make 'em understand!
Just who's the strongest around here!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The stage is set.
Now, it is your turn to dance."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
While singing hymns of praise to the Overlord,
from behind me, of course.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Sounds good.
Now I'm getting excited.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (I don't know about the me in another world, but—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (...I desired this. To contest an era alongside you all—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Now, shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Our Japan Cup.
